question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Explicit
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e**. 'Specific'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Explicit" **means stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.
 
• It refers to something that is clearly expressed or demonstrated.
 
• The word that has a** similar meaning** to **"Explicit**" is** 'Specific'.**
 
• "**Specific"** - means clearly defined or identified, which is similar to the meaning of explicit.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Specific'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other options:
 
 
• **"Perfect" **in English means being completely without fault or defect.(सम्पूर्ण)
 
• **"Nebulous"** in English means hazy, vague, indistinct, or confused.(अस्पष्ट)
 
• **"Vogue"** in English refers to the prevailing fashion or style at a particular time.(फैशन)
